title: ai-spend source document
description: What every ai-spend fetcher writes and report.py reads. A new source (for example the Langfuse adapter seam in SKILL.md) is added by writing this shape; report.py needs no change. Money is a decimal string, never a JSON number.

source.description: anthropic_api | aws_bedrock | snowflake_cortex | claude_code_local; langfuse is reserved for the adapter seam

status.description: unknown: the source has no data yet for the window (shown as UNKNOWN, never 0); error: the fetch failed; partial: some of the window or some attribution is missing

day.description: UTC day the usage falls on

user.description: who the usage is attributed to; null when the source attributes it to nobody

usd_basis.description: billed: from invoice-grade billing data; list: a quantity times a public list rate; estimated_api_equivalent: tokens times API list prices, not money spent. Never added across bases.

counts_toward_total.description: false for attribution-only rows whose cost is already in another row

excluded_reason.description: set when a row is kept out of every sum, e.g. a known double count
